# 0.2.0 — FieldInfo YAML templates

18 September 2026. Minor on the public **0.1.8** beta.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.2.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

## Changed

- `opentide generate templates` walks Pydantic `FieldInfo` instead of the JSON Schema `gen_template` walker ([#223](https://github.com/OpenTideHQ/opentide/issues/223)).
- Optional sections are commented YAML with `#` hugging each key (`#references:` / `  #public:`). Nested optionals are not commented again. Spacer blanks stay blank.
- Placeholders are typed (no YAML `null`). Nested bodies come from nested models.
- Rule `configurations` are commented platform stubs (`#sentinel:`) rather than `{}`.
- VS Code snippet conversion treats commented nested keys as mapping children, so `configurations:` with only `#sentinel:` stubs is not turned into a tabstop.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide setup --yes --name "Tutorial Detections" --org "Example Corp" --platform sentinel --path /tmp/tutorial-detections
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections generate
opentide --repo /tmp/tutorial-detections validate --strict
```

Expect `0.2.0`. `.opentide/templates/rule.1.0.template.yaml` must contain `#sentinel:`, hug `#` to keys (`  #enabled:`, not `#  enabled:`), keep spacer blanks (no lone `#`), and contain no YAML `null`.
